claim_boundary: one look at the issue110-evaluation grid cells (and the #109 evaluation split as N1 reference) for request policies trained on normal data and few-shot retuned on the novel fit sides; tie-free cost; DESCRIPTIVE intervals; no closed-loop claim

decision_rule.disposition: 'request selection is a cheap adaptation surface under novelty', J_dec primary (J secondary, same rule), on the pooled novel population (every mixed evaluation level of the in-scope cells of novelty levels [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], x 3 seeds, member = evaluation level): (a) gain = AUC(J_dec policy-only retune) - AUC(J_dec zero-shot), delta rule (supported iff mean >= 0.02 and lower > 0; not supported iff upper < 0.02); (b) parity = AUC(J_dec policy-only) - AUC(J_dec predictor-only), non-inferiority (supported iff lower > -0.02; not supported iff upper < -0.02); (c) cheap = the summed GPU seconds of the policy-only retunes (levels x seeds) are below the summed #110 few-shot hybrid predictor member training GPU seconds of the same levels and seeds. supported iff (a) and (b) are supported and (c) holds; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff (a) or (b) is not supported or (c) fails; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient. A failed guard turns every token into readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.secondary: per novelty type and per cell, every AUC and contrast is DESCRIPTIVE with the same token rules; zero-shot: J / J_dec - F_hindsight (in-population best fixed request, outcome-selected), - F-15-macro (pre-declared), - no-model prior, J_dec - J; few-shot: policy - zero-shot, policy - predictor (non-inferiority), predictor - zero-shot, both - predictor, both - zero-shot, policy / predictor / both - F_hindsight of their world, - few-shot prior; wrong-anchor right - wrong (delta rule)
decision_rule.shares: request share = the share of rollout steps (transitions) choosing each of the nine requests, pooled over the 16 candidates of a level, per (level, seed); shift = the arm's shares on a novel level minus the same-kind normal policy's shares on the paired normal side (same pair and ordinal, zero-shot world, same seed); TV = half the L1 norm of the shift; 'moves toward' = shift interval above 0, 'moves away' = below 0 (DESCRIPTIVE); every evaluation level of the in-scope cells (outcome-free). N1 references: the normal policies on the #109 evaluation split (same v2 zero-shot world) and the #101 J / J_dec records (E99 Gate-B predictor)

disclosure: Known before the freeze: every #101 / Gate-B / #110 published result (#110 rollout error per cell, few-shot level-7 F-1 divergence, identifiability), and the per-cell mixed-level counts of the handoff. No request policy has been trained on a v2 world; no policy output on an evaluation capture exists. Hardware: RTX 5090 instead of the #85 RTX 3090.
